// diagnostic E2719

Jet.GrammarLeftRecursive

This grammar has left recursion outside the operator form

What

This grammar has left recursion outside the operator form

Why

A generated parser reads from the left, so a rule that can begin with itself would call itself forever; only a rule's own operator alternatives may begin with it.

Fix

Write the recursion as operator alternatives of one rule, or factor the shared start out of the rules.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GrammarLeftRecursive: Tests/UI/grammar_left_recursive.stderr.

Error: Jet.GrammarLeftRecursive: Left recursion `expr -> term -> expr` is not the operator form
  --> Tests/UI/grammar_left_recursive.jet:6:5
    |
  6 |     expr : term '+' NUM | NUM ;
    |     ^
 Why: A generated parser reads from the left, so a rule that can begin with itself would call itself forever; only a rule's own operator alternatives may begin with it
 Fix: Factor the shared start out of these rules, or merge them into one rule in the operator form
